messages.text: I received my hammer d02 yesterday it has a damaged screen and does not have harlow

Sorry, that's not how it should arrive. A damaged screen goes through RMA: fill the intake form and you'll get a return label, processing takes up to 10 days after the unit lands at the warehouse. Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

On Harlo OS, the firmware and flashing instructions live at https://harlolabs.com/ — that's the only link to use.

One thing I have to ask for the RMA: has the unit been overclocked or modified at all?
no it is right out of the box

Good, stock and untouched means it's covered. Put it through the RMA form now and note the damaged screen in the description, photos of the screen and the box help. They'll send you a return label, and processing runs up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse.

If the firmware side is still off after you check harlolabs.com, tell me what it shows on boot and I'll get our hardware guy on it.

Also I joined discord and the adminstrator removed me for some reason.  I cannot connect with you that way.  I have tried Harlow on three different miners each one resets overnight and has to be set up again.
Handed to the team · Firmware settings not persisting across power cycles on multiple units, beyond p

Three units resetting overnight isn't normal. First thing to try: change settings, hit save, then reboot from the web interface rather than pulling the plug, so the config writes to flash before power goes.

If it still wipes, that's firmware, and I've pinged our team, our hardware guy handles this. Stay in the chat and someone will jump in here. I've passed the Discord removal along too so they can get you back in.
I flashed them back to factory firmware

Understood, and to be clear, going back to stock firmware is fine, it doesn't affect the RMA on the damaged screen. That's a warranty case either way as long as nothing was overclocked.

Tell me which units you flashed and what version of Harlo you were on when the settings kept wiping, and I'll add it to what the team already has. That detail is what our hardware guy will ask for first.
no the DC02 unit i just received does not have Harlow it has hammer os.  I originally had two seperate bitaxe 601 and one nerdQaxe++ i tried the harlow firmware on.

Got it, that's clearer. The D.02 ships with Hammer OS, so that one isn't a fault, and the screen damage is the only thing going through RMA there.

The overnight resets were on the two Bitaxe 601s and the NerdQaxe++ running Harlo, which is a different problem, and I've passed that to our hardware guy with those units named. He'll pick it up here.

Anything else while you're waiting?
